function.name: delete_sap_object
function.description: Delete an ENTIRE class or program (the whole object disappears). Use ONLY when the user explicitly asks to delete/drop the complete program or class. Permanent operation; a mandatory user confirmation popup is shown before deletion. NEVER use this tool to remove a PART of an object - deleting a FORM/subroutine, a method, a block of code, header comments, or lines is a MODIFICATION: use modify_sap_object on that object instead.

object_type.description: Only entire programs or classes can be deleted

object_name.description: Exact technical name of the object to delete. Never empty.

reason.description: Why the object is being deleted (shown in the confirmation popup)
